text:
sonia: Heads-up — starting a quick thread for Q3/Q4 private deploy decisioning. We need to pick a primary path: 'Control plane first (VPC control plane)' vs 'Packaging first (on-prem agent + airgap packaging)'. Customers asking for both; can't deliver everything immediately. Thoughts?

mike: +1 to control plane first for enterprise customers. It's lower friction for ops teams and enables rollout policies.

raj: Control plane unlocks RBAC, metrics, and remote upgrades. Packaging first buys us airgap creds and easier offline installs. tradeoffs: control plane = network config complexity; packaging = heavier SRE support burden.

kevin: Security note — control plane means we must nail tenant segregation and KMS integration. Packaging-first reduces network exposure but requires HSM/KMS on-prem support. Both need threat model writeups.

lisa: From SE: most pilot customers prefer control plane (VPC) because they want central management. A couple regulated customers insist on airgap packaging though.

omar: Ops question — If we do control plane first, can we delay airgap packaging by 2 quarters and offer a 'connector' for restricted networks? small lightweight agent?

mike: technically feasible: start with VPC control plane + on-prem connector (1.0 limited feature set). Packaging (full airgap) = larger engineering effort due to signing, offline deps.

sonia: Proposed path: 1) Q3: ship VPC control plane MVP + connector 1.0; 2) Q4: iterate packaging and airgap for top regulated customers. OKRs: "Private GA" metric = X customers onboarded to VPC control plane; "Airgap readiness" = package validation & 2 pilot installs.

kevin: +emoji :thumbsup: Need to add compliance checklist item for packaging: reproducible builds, SBOM, signed images, upgrade procedures.

raj: Implementation note: runtime teams need a deterministic build pipeline. I'll block time for build infra in Q3 planning.

lisa: Can we create a decision doc for sales that maps customer asks to expected timelines? SEs need an FAQ and risk table.

sonia: I'll draft a short doc and share tomorrow. Action items:
- sonia: draft public roadmap note + FAQ
- mike/raj: estimate connector effort (sprint points)
- kevin: compliance checklist
- lisa: customer prioritization (who needs airgap now)

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: roadmap-draft-v1 -> staging at 09:12 UTC

omar: Thanks — leaving this here. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock control-plane-first path.

mike: no objections from eng side.

kevin: no objections from security.

sonia: locking plan. will post summary and start RFC.
